architecture:
System: Data-Exchange-086
Primary NIST family: Maintenance (MA); evidence focus: MA-4.
Environment: Azure Government. Network access uses Private Link; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a customer-managed Key Vault key. Control evidence: nonlocal maintenance occurs only through monitored, strongly authenticated, time-limited sessions. No exceptions, overdue findings, plaintext channels, public databases, or privileged-authentication gaps are reported.
